items.notes: Abigor makes four attacks using its Warhammer, Throwing Hammer, or a combination of the two.

items.name: Warhammer
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

items.name: Throwing Hammer
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage. Hammers thrown this way fall and stick into the ground after hitting their target and a new hammer appears in Abigor's hand.

items.name: Thunderous Slam
items.notes: Abigor causes all its hammers left on the battlefield to bristle with thunderous energy, exploding outwards with a roar. All creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on each hammer must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature is within multiple spheres, it must make the save multiple times, taking damage from each source.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede Abigor's darkvision.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Abigor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Throw Hammer
items.notes: Abigor makes a Throwing Hammer attack.

items.name: Call Thunder
items.notes: Abigor targets a hammer that it can see within 60 feet to let out a thunderous roar. Creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the hammer must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Aeshma makes two attacks using his Shortsword, Hand Crossbow, or a combination of the two.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Cunning
items.notes: Aeshma takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

items.name: Proboscis
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. Creatures damaged by this attack must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or suffer the Infernal Rot disease.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede the kocrachon's darkvision.

items.name: Infernal Rot
items.notes: A creature afflicted with this disease has the poisoned condition until the disease ends. While diseased, creatures gain no benefits from a long rest, gaining exhaustion when necessary. If a creature dies while afflicted with Infernal Rot, its corpse transforms into a newborn kocrachon after 4 (1d8) days.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The kocrachon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Sadism
items.notes: The kocrachon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for each different creature it damaged on its previous turn.

items.notes: Anacreda makes two Claw attacks. She can replace one of the attacks with a Crushing Hug attack.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

items.name: Crushing Hug
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 51 (8d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, Anacreda grabs it with both arms. The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 73 (12d10 + 7) necrotic damage at the start of each of Anacreda's turns. Anacreda can't make attacks while grappling a creature in this way.

items.name: Spinewall
items.notes: Anacreda causes a 50-foot-long, 5-foot-wide row of bones to pierce the earth at a point within 120 feet of her. She chooses the direction of the line. The bones rise 10 feet into the air and form a solid wall. A 5-foot section of bone has an AC of 20 and 10 hit points.

items.name: Shattering Shriek
items.notes: Anacreda shrieks loud enough to shatter stone and bone alike. Each creature within a 50-foot-radius sphere centered on Anacreda must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 55 (10d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Unworked stone, exposed bone, and similar materials in the radius are shattered and turned into difficult terrain.

items.notes: Anagwendol makes two attacks using her Defending Greatsword, Longbow, or a combination of the two.

items.name: Defending Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

items.name: Longbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

items.name: Healing Touch
items.notes: Anagwendol touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

items.name: Defensive Sword-work
items.notes: Anagwendol can forgo attacking with her Defending Greatsword on this turn and gain a +3 to her armor class. She can still attack with her Longbow.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Anagwendol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Slow
items.notes: The animated furniture targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Immutable Form
items.notes: The animated furniture is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The animated furniture has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons

conditional.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Asmodeus makes four attacks using Ruby Rod, Chilling Gaze, or a combination of the two. He can replace one of the attacks with Hellish Smite.

items.name: Ruby Rod
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +21 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d8 + 12) necrotic damage, which also reduces the target's hit point maximum by the damage taken. This damage can't reduce a target's hit point maximum below 1. Any effect that removes a disease allows a creature's hit point maximum to return to normal.

items.name: Chilling Gaze
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +16 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) cold damage, and the target has a -1 penalty to all attack rolls they make until the end of their next turn. This penalty can stack.

items.name: Hellish Smite
items.notes: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 300 feet of him, calling down a bolt of hellish lightning. The target must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Infernal Word: Stun
items.notes: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 24 Intelligence saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that failed the save is stunned for up to 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

items.name: Hell-Lord's Suggestion
items.notes: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 24 Charisma saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that failed the save has the charmed condition for up to 1 minute. While charmed, a creature is controlled by Asmodeus, performing only actions that he suggests. A charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

items.name: Fires of the Nine Hells
items.notes: Asmodeus chooses a point he can see within 500 feet of him, which explodes into a roaring inferno. All creatures within a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Ruby Absorption
items.notes: As a reaction to being the sole target of a spell, Asmodeus can attempt to absorb the spell into the Ruby Rod. Asmodeus rolls (1d20 + 2), and if the result is higher than (10 + spell level), the spell is absorbed into the rod and has no effect.

items.name: Antimagic Aura
items.notes: Asmodeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Spells of level 4 or lower can't damage Asmodeus.

items.name: Fiendish Regeneration
items.notes: Asmodeus regains 40 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Asmodeus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate. If Asmodeus dies, his body regenerates, returning to life 13 (2d12) days later.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Asmodeus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Submission Aura
items.notes: When a creature moves to be within 120 feet of Asmodeus, they must succeed on a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. While frightened, creatures kneel before Asmodeus, taking no actions unless he commands otherwise. If Asmodeus deals damage to a kneeling creature, the creature's frightened condition ends. A creature that succeeds the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

items.name: Channel Ruby Rod
items.notes: The Ruby Rod has 66 charges. Asmodeus may spend its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, with a spell save DC of 20: Lesser Restoration (3 charges), Wall of Force (7 charges), Greater Restoration (12 charges), Chain Lightning (15 charges), Prismatic Spray (23 charges), Globe of Invulnerability (33 charges)

items.name: Strike
items.notes: Asmodeus makes a Ruby Rod attack.

items.name: Call Underling
items.notes: Asmodeus summons an allied pit fiend in an unoccupied space that he can see.

lair_actions.header: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Asmodeus can take one lair action to cause the following effect or one from the archdevil lair action list (page 214); he can't take the same lair action two rounds in a row:

items.name: Cleansing Flame
items.notes: Asmodeus selects one spell effect on himself or a creature of his choice within 60 feet. That spell effect is removed.

items.name: Attack
items.notes: The archdevil uses one of their available melee or ranged attacks against a single foe.

items.name: Cast a Spell
items.notes: The archdevil uses their Spellcasting feature to cast an available spell. If the spell normally requires concentration, it lasts for the full duration instead.

items.name: Deceitful Whispers
items.notes: The archdevil whispers to a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the charmed condition until the start of their next turn and must use their reaction immediately to make an attack against one of the archdevil's enemies, chosen by the archdevil.

items.name: Fiendish Fortitude
items.notes: The archdevil recharges one of their expended abilities.

items.name: Frenzy
items.notes: The archdevil casts Haste on themself. The effect ends at initiative count 20 of the next round.

items.name: Summon Underlings
items.notes: The archdevil summons allied devils. The devils summoned depends on the archdevil using this feature. The summoned devils appear in unoccupied spaces which the archdevil can see. The Archdevil Lair Action List; Summoned Underlings table shows which devils each archdevil can summon.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: The archdevil teleports themself to an area they can see within 120 feet.

items.name: Trap
items.notes: The archdevil casts the Hold Monster spell.

regional_effects.header:
The region containing Asmodeus's lair is corrupted by his presence, which creates the following effect:

If Asmodeus dies, the effects fade over the course of 1d10 days.

items.name: The Devil's Greeting
items.notes: Within 500 miles of his lair, an illusory version of Asmodeus (as if he has cast the Project Image spell) appears. Asmodeus attempts to communicate with any characters and decipher their intentions. If they're hostile, Asmodeus pretends to prepare himself for combat, in an effort to make the character's waste their resources.

items.notes: The avatar makes four Sickening Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Insect Gorge (if available).

items.name: Sickening Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by the acid damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

items.name: Insect Gorge
items.notes: The avatar disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point it can see within 300 feet of itself. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 55 (10d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The biting flies persist for 1 minute or until the avatar is slain. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the insects' area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

items.name: Caustic Slimepool
items.notes: The avatar causes caustic slime to emanate from itself, covering a 15-foot-radius circle. Each creature within the slime must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or have the grappled condition (escape DC 17). A grappled creature takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of its turn.

items.name: Stench of the Slug
items.notes: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the avatar must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of their next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The fisher makes two Claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage.

items.name: Retract Filament
items.notes: One Huge or smaller creature grappled by the fisher's Adhesive Filament must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the fisher, and the fisher makes one Claw attack against it with advantage. Anyone else who was attached to the filament is released. Until the grapple ends on the target, the fisher can't use Adhesive Filament.

items.name: Adhesive Filament
items.notes: The fisher extends a sticky filament up to 90 feet in a straight line, which adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature the filament adheres to has the grappled condition (escape DC 20), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The filament can be attacked (AC 16; 25 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). A weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful DC 20 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament deals no damage to the fisher. The filament crumbles away if the fisher takes this bonus action again.

items.name: Flammable Blood
items.notes: If the fisher drops below 200 hit points, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the fisher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Slash
items.notes: The fisher makes a Claw attack.

items.name: Spit
items.notes: The fisher uses Adhesive Filament.

items.name: Reel In
items.notes: The fisher uses Retract Filament.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The ayperobo swarm makes three Bite attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (8d4 + 7) piercing damage, or 17 (4d4 + 7) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points (65) or fewer.

items.name: Burrow
items.notes:
The ayperobo swarm makes a Bite attack. On a hit, the swarm burrows inside the creature, dealing an additional 35 (10d6) necrotic damage and taking control of the creature. At the start of each of its turns, the target may make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, expelling the ayperobo swarm and taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage on a success.

While burrowed inside a creature, the ayperobo swarm has total cover against attacks targeting them, and no longer acts on their own initiative. Instead, they take total control over their host, gaining all of its abilities, attacks, and equipment.

They act during the host's turn, taking actions based on their host. If a host dies while the ayperobo swarm is burrowed, they leave the host at the end of the host's turn, rolling initiative if necessary. Creatures acting as hosts to the ayperobo swarm are fully aware of their actions and surroundings, but are incapable of physically operating their body.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede the ayperobo swarm's darkvision.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The ayperobo swarm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Swarm
items.notes: The ayperobo swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The ayperobo swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

Creatures that fail the save have the poisoned condition for 1 minute.

items.name: Heart of Pestilence
items.notes: Baalzebul channels pestilence into his body, sickening creatures within 50 feet that can see him. Sickened creatures must make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, followed by a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Failing the Charisma save makes a creature have the frightened condition, while failing the Constitution save makes a creature weak. While weakened, a creature deals half damage on melee attacks. Both effects last for 1 minute or until a Greater Restoration spell or similar is cast.

items.name: Displace
items.notes: Baalzebul magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede Baalzebul's darkvision.

items.name: Fiendish Regeneration
items.notes: Baalzebul regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Baalzebul dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Lord of Flies
items.notes: Insects don't attack Baalzebul, and he can issue orders to them.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Baalzebul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Baalzebul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Stench of the Slug
items.notes: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Baalzebul must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

items.name: Pummel
items.notes: Baalzebul makes a Slam attack.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Baalzebul uses Displace.

items.name: Insect Gorge
items.notes: Baalzebul disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point he can see within 300 feet of himself. Creatures that enter the flies' area or end their turn inside it must repeat the saving throw.

items.name: Call Underling
items.notes: Baalzebul summons an allied bone devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

items.name: Tail
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 22). The dragon can't make a Tail attack while a creature is grappled in this way.

items.name: Constrict
items.notes: The dragon tightens its grip on a creature grappled by its tail. The creature takes 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage, has the restrained condition until the start of the dragon's next turn, and must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target contracts Stygian Wasting.

items.name: Frightful Presence
items.notes: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Stygian Breath
items.notes: The dragon exhales poisonous Styx water in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line. Each creature in that line must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save contract Stygian Wasting.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The dragon can breathe air and water.

items.name: Stygian Wasting
items.notes: Creatures afflicted with this disease are incapable of regaining hit points in any way until the disease is cured. Additionally, as their flesh starts to rot, a creature with this disease takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage after each long rest they finish.

items.name: Styx Dweller
items.notes: The dragon is immune to all negative effects from the River Styx.

items.name: Detect
items.notes: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

items.name: Tail Attack
items.notes: The dragon makes a Tail attack. If a creature is already grappled, the dragon may use Constrict instead.

items.name: Death Throw
items.notes: If the dragon has successfully restrained a creature with the Constrict ability, it may throw them up to 100 feet away. When it lands, the creature takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the unconscious condition for 10 minutes.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Tiax casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

items.name: Touch of Decay
items.notes: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (6d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

items.name: Unholy Firebolt
items.notes: Tiax causes unholy fire to flare up in a creature's space within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

items.name: Heal
items.notes: Tiax heals 70 hit points.

items.name: Gnome Cunning
items.notes: Tiax has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Tiax wears a Ring of Resistance that grants him resistance to radiant damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The shadow makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Shadows of Death (if available).

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) necrotic damage, plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

items.name: Cloak of Shadows
items.notes: The shadow bends darkness around itself, and now has the invisible condition for 1 minute. The invisibility ends if the shadow is subjected to a Daylight spell or similar.

items.name: Empathic Link
items.notes: The shadow attempts to form a link between itself and a creature it can see. The target must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw, taking 13 (2d12) psychic damage on a success. On a failed save, the creature and the shadow are linked. While linked, every time the shadow is damaged, the creature takes half of that damage as psychic damage. The creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 13 (2d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or ending the effect on a successful one.

items.name: Shadows of Death
items.notes: The shadow discharges inky-black shadows in a 90-foot-radius sphere around itself. Creatures in the shadows must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A frightened creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

items.name: Change Shape
items.notes: The shadow transforms into a Beast, Humanoid or Fiend that it has an Empathic Link with, or back into its true form. In a new form, the shadow retains its alignment, hit points, hit dice, telepathy, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features, lair actions, or legendary actions of that form.

items.name: Empath
items.notes: The shadow uses telepathy to sense nearby creatures. The shadow can see a creature if that creature has thoughts and is within the range of the shadow's telepathy. The shadow can't see creatures immune to telepathy.

items.name: Undying Connection
items.notes: The shadow was originally spawned from a specific devil and, if the shadow is slain, it returns to life in 10 (1d20) days within 1 mile of that devil. The shadow is killed permanently only if its progenitor devil is slain first.

items.name: Shadow Blink
items.notes: The shadow surrounds itself in black mist, then teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see.

items.name: Shapeshift
items.notes: The shadow uses its Change Shape ability.

items.name: Mind Spike
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack Roll: +11 to hit, range 300 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) psychic damage.

name: Vorvolaka
languages: the languages it knew in life

conditional.note: from nonmagical attacks

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The vorvolaka makes two Talon attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Rend Armor (if available).

items.name: Talon
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

items.name: Rend Armor
items.notes: The vorvolaka makes a Talon attack against a creature. On a hit, the creature's AC is reduced by 2 for 1 minute. Creatures not wearing armor are immune to this effect, and the total reduction can't bring a creature below an AC of 10.

items.name: Fear Aura
items.notes: Any hostile creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the vorvolaka must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have frightened condition until the start of the creature's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, they're immune to the vorvolaka's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours. This ability does not function if the vorvolaka is unconscious.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The vorvolaka has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: The vorvolaka regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the vorvolaka takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vorvolaka's next turn.

conditional.note: from nonmagical attacks

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Waeloquay makes three Slam attacks.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Whelm
items.notes: Each creature in Waeloquay's space must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it also has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe, unless it can breathe water. If the save is successful, the target is pushed out of Waeloquay's space. Waeloquay can grapple one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of Waeloquay's turns, each target grappled by it takes 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 feet of Waeloquay can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a DC 22 Strength check and succeeding.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Waeloquay has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Waeloquay fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Water Form
items.notes: Waeloquay can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

items.name: Flow
items.notes: Waeloquay moves up to its speed.

items.name: Crush (Costs 2 Actions)
items.notes: One creature that Waeloquay is grappling takes 44 (8d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Pummel (Costs 2 Actions)
items.notes: Waeloquay makes a Slam attack with advantage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The war devil makes two attacks using its Cold- Iron Ranseur, Claws, or a combination of the two.

items.name: Cold-Iron Ranseur
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) force damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage.

items.name: Claws
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). While a creature is grappled, the war devil can't make Claws attacks.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede the war devil's darkvision.

items.name: Fear Aura
items.notes: Any hostile creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the war devil must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of the creature's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the war devil's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours. This ability doesn't function if the war devil is unconscious.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The war devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Zagum makes three attacks with Disarming Tongue or Oration.

items.name: Disarming Tongue
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) slashing damage. A target hit by this attack has vulnerability to psychic damage until the start of their next turn.

items.name: Oration
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +14 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) psychic damage.

items.name: Legal Jargon
items.notes:
Zagum chooses a point he can see within 90 feet of him. All creatures within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures that fail the save are confused for up to 1 minute and must roll a d10 at the start of each of their turns.
On a 1, a creature moves in a random direction then ends their turn. On a 2-6, a creature can't use actions this turn. On a 7-8, a creature must use their action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within their reach that is not a Fiend. On a 9-10, a creature can move and act normally.
A confused creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Contractually Obligated
items.notes: Zagum has advantage to hit creatures under an infernal contract and when he hits such creatures he delivers an additional 9 (2d8) damage of a type the target is most vulnerable to. A creature bound under an infernal contract also makes all saving throws against effects originating from Zagum with disadvantage.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede Zagum's darkvision.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Zagum has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Zariel casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26):

spells.name: alter self
spells.note: can become medium when changing her appearance

conditional.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Zariel makes three Flail or Longsword attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Horrid Touch, if available.

items.name: Flail
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) force damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.

items.name: Longsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) radiant damage or 19 (2d10 + 8) radiant damage when used with two hands, plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.

items.name: Horrid Touch
items.notes: Zariel touches one creature within 10 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) necrotic damage and have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target has the blinded and deafened conditions. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Zariel magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede Zariel's darkvision.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Zariel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Zariel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: Zariel regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Zariel dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Zariel uses Teleport.

items.name: Immolating Gaze
items.notes: Zariel turns her magical gaze toward one creature she can see within 120 feet of her and commands it to burn. The target must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (4d10) fire damage.

lair_actions.header: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Zariel can take one lair action to cause the following effect or one from the archdevil lair action list (page 214); she can't take the same lair action two rounds in a row:

items.name: Infernal Illusions
items.notes: Zariel casts the Major Image spell four times, targeting different areas with it. Zariel prefers to create images of intruders' loved ones being burned alive. Zariel doesn't need to concentrate on the spells, which end on initiative count 20 of the next round. Each creature that can see these illusions must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Attack
items.notes: The archdevil uses one of their available melee or ranged attacks against a single foe.

items.name: Cast a Spell
items.notes: The archdevil uses their Spellcasting feature to cast an available spell. If the spell normally requires concentration, it lasts for the full duration instead.

items.name: Deceitful Whispers
items.notes: The archdevil whispers to a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the charmed condition until the start of their next turn and must use their reaction immediately to make an attack against one of the archdevil's enemies, chosen by the archdevil.

items.name: Fiendish Fortitude
items.notes: The archdevil recharges one of their expended abilities.

items.name: Frenzy
items.notes: The archdevil casts Haste on themself. The effect ends at initiative count 20 of the next round.

items.name: Summon Underlings
items.notes: The archdevil summons allied devils. The devils summoned depends on the archdevil using this feature. The summoned devils appear in unoccupied spaces which the archdevil can see. The Archdevil Lair Action List; Summoned Underlings table shows which devils each archdevil can summon.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: The archdevil teleports themself to an area they can see within 120 feet.

items.name: Trap
items.notes: The archdevil casts the Hold Monster spell.

regional_effects.header:
The region containing Zariel's lair is warped by her magic, which creates the following effect:

If Zariel dies, these effects fade over the course of 1d10 days.

items.name: Hellscape
items.notes: The area within 9 miles of the lair is filled with screaming voices and the stench of burning meat.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Zythan casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).

conditional.note: from nonmagical attacks (from Stoneskin)

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Zythan makes three Dagger or Arcane Burst attacks.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Arcane Burst
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) radiant damage.

items.name: Spirit Fissure
items.notes: Zythan causes a disruption in arcane energies in a 300-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 65 (10d12) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Portent
items.notes: As a reaction to a creature Zythan can see making an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, Zythan rolls a d20 and chooses whether to use that roll in place of the original roll.

items.name: Battlemage
items.notes: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on Zythan's ranged attack rolls.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Zythan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
